description: This file defines a class A2ACostCalculator that calculates costs for agent-to-agent (A2A) calls, supporting dynamic cost parameters such as fixed query costs and token-based costs, with methods to compute total costs based on call details and token usage.

classes.name: A2ACostCalculator
classes.description: Provides static methods to calculate A2A call costs based on various parameters and usage details.

methods.name: calculate_a2a_cost
methods.description: Calculates the cost of an A2A send_message call, considering response cost, fixed query cost, or token-based costs.

methods.name: _calculate_token_based_cost
methods.description: Calculates cost based on token usage and per-token pricing, summing input and output token costs.
